invariants.rationale: Every non-exceptional exit constructs and returns a new BulkInsertPartitioner instance.
Only these BulkInsertSortMode values do not throw an exception; otherwise, the method does not return.
JavaNonSortPartitioner is returned if and only if sortMode is NONE.
JavaGlobalSortPartitioner is returned if and only if sortMode is GLOBAL_SORT.
All returned objects are valid BulkInsertPartitioner instances.
